name: How long does textured stucco typically last?

mainEntity.name: How long does textured stucco typically last?

acceptedAnswer.text: Properly applied and maintained textured stucco can last for several decades, often 50 years or more. Its durability is a key advantage. Factors influencing its lifespan include the quality of materials, the skill of installation, and how well it's maintained over time. Regular cleaning, timely repairs of any cracks, and ensuring proper drainage can significantly extend the life of your stucco finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Well-applied and maintained textured stucco can last 50+ years, with durability depending on materials, installation, and ongoing care.
